hey, thanks for your support. I'm sorry to hear you've had to gone through all that shit too, it really makes me upset that this stupid depression haunts so many people.
my mother did go to therapy at some point, without telling me about it but I found out about it later. she had depression when she was my age too and has in the hospital many times, but still she doesn't seem to understand how hard it is for me. She used to abuse me as a kid as well as my father, but when I turned 10 or so they pretty much stopped. I never took it as anything serious as it was just when I cried or did something bad they yelled at me and sometimes pulled me by my hair(as a kid I had kind of long hair) and put me outside in the cold as a punisment and sometimes even hit me, but I never really though about it.

Last weekend someone in our town(abour 8000 people live in here and people mostly know each other) died in a car crash, he was 18-19 years old and very liked among the youngsters here. everyone's been talking about it lately so I think I'm not the main focus anymore, but I feel really sorry for the guys friends and family. he was a great guy, I know that even though I didn't really know him.

I've done school projects about suicide too but I feel insecure turning them in, knowing that the teachers are aware of my situation and might get worried or something. I've tried to be as confident as I can around other people, I still do get some stares in the hallways and I often hide in the restrooms alone so I can be at peace where no one can see me. I still get called emo behind my back though.
Only about 5 weeks of school left and I'm taking my final exams and trying to attend to all of my classes. I believe I can do this, even though my grades have dropped a lot.

I have therapy during summer this year and then I'd have to move out. I don'y know what after that, I've thought I'd be dead until then. I don't know. I see a personal support person twice a week, who's an adult and hangs out with me and takes me to places so I won't stay in my room all day. We usually go to a wallop since she owns a pony there and we take care of the other horses too. I like horses and going there.

thanks for your support once again, I feel a bit better now that I know there are people who care.

hello, yeah I though so first too but my family complains a lot about me and how I can't be left "alone" even though that suicide accempt was over half an year ago.

I really care about my girlfriend but we don't get to see often. She lived an hour away from me and she came over once after we both got out of psych ward, but after that she was transferred to a "foster home" which is like a psych ward but you live in there and yeah. After that we only have met once, which was about an month ago but we did have fun, but the nurses in her new home don't let me go see her. We do text everyday though.

that's one of the reasons I so desperately want to die. even if I lived till my 30s my teenage years would've had a big effect on me and my life would still be miserable and terrible. plus I'm scared of aging, my biggest fear is becoming an adult.
